source_title: Selena Gomez Reveals Her Honest Reaction to Her Viral ‘Got Some Blue Hair Going on’ Meme from 2007 - People.com
source_excerpt:
Gomez reunited with Demi Lovato to look back at some of their most iconic moments
Jeff Vespa/WireImage; Michael Buckner/Variety via Getty
Selena Gomez and Demi Lovato looked at old photos of themselves as part of their new Rare Beauty campaign, which released on Oct. 28
In the video, Gomez reacted to her viral blue hairstyle from when she attended a Teen Vogue party in 2007
The campaign nods to Gomez and Lovato’s roles in Princess Protection Program , which released in 2009
Selena Gomez will never live this moment down.
The actress, 34, reunited with former costar Demi Lovato for a fairytale Rare Beauty campaign that shines a light on their decades-long friendship while nodding to their 2009 Disney film, Princess Protection Program .
To celebrate their “Still Making Each Other Blush” collaboration debuting the Delena Soft Pinch Blush Bundle , the dynamic duo sat down for a “Life in Selfies” YouTube video and reacted to photos of their younger selves — and their past fashion choices.
As the singers looked at photos of them taken over the years, Gomez came upon a snapshot of herself from the 2007 Teen Vogue Young Hollywood Party — and it sparked quite the memory for the Only Murders in the Building star.
“So remember your video where you got to say that your favorite dish is a mug,” Gomez said to Lovato in reference to the latter’s viral 2015 interview when she mistakenly thought the question was in reference to kitchenware instead of food. “Well this is the video for me,” said Gomez, “where I was like, ‘I got some blue going on.’ ”
In the full interview, shared by The Hollywood Fix , Gomez was filmed saying, “I got some blue going on. I like a little edge, a little pop in my hair so I wanted to add something different, especially for the Teen Vogue party.”
“ What?” Gomez said while rolling her eyes , before having a kinder reaction to her past self. “You know what? I’m proud of that.” Lovato, 34, added, “I think it’s cute.”
At the beginning of the video, Gomez and Lovato also reacted to a picture of them on the set of Barney & Friends , the show that brought them together when they both auditioned at 7 years old. “We would tap the microphones so for some reason we were talking about things,” reflected Gomez.
In a press release for the new Rare Beauty campaign, Gomez and Lovato reflected on their nearly 25-year bond.
“Selena and I have shared a lot of memories over the years since childhood, so being able to connect in this way, in a campaign that feels so nostalgic to both of us, is such a full-circle moment,” Lovato said in a press release. “I’ve loved her liquid blush since she launched the brand so this was really fun to work on. Being on set together felt like we were back in our old bedrooms making YouTube videos and playing with makeup.” ​

Gomez added, “The experiences I’ve shared with Demi are truly unique. Coming together for this campaign was a beautiful reminder of that history and a chance to celebrate who we are today. One and the same….always.”
